rules.name: tag-cardinality
rules.description: Every project in scope must carry a number of distinct tag values on one axis inside a declared range

axis.description: The tag axis counted — the segment before the first ":" of a tag

min.description: The fewest distinct axis values an in-scope project may carry (integer >= 0); at least one of min or max must be present

max.description: The most distinct axis values an in-scope project may carry (integer >= min)

match.description: Tags an in-scope project must carry all of; absent means every project; an empty array is malformed

rules.name: forbidden-tag-combination
rules.description: A project carrying one declared set of tags together is a violation, whatever else it carries

tags.description: The forbidden combination: a project carrying ALL of these tags violates

rules.name: max-fan-out
rules.description: A project may not depend on more distinct projects than a declared budget

max.description: The most distinct projects an in-scope project may depend on (integer >= 0)

match.description: Tags an in-scope project must carry all of; absent means every project; an empty array is malformed

rules.name: max-fan-in
rules.description: A project may not be depended on by more distinct projects than a declared budget

max.description: The most distinct projects that may depend on an in-scope project (integer >= 0)

match.description: Tags an in-scope project must carry all of; absent means every project; an empty array is malformed
